service.description: The rows of WorkItems: the work items of the projects the user sees, in one smart list, narrowed by the find, sorted and paged, each decorated (decorate#WorkItemRows), with the count of each smart list in the given project (without the other find fields). The smart lists: open (the default: not Complete, Closed or Cancelled), mine (open, the user an Assignee), reported (open, the user its owner or Reporter), watching (open, a Watcher or a follower), unassigned (open, no Assignee), week (open and due from today through seven days), overdue (open and due before today), recent (changed in the last seven days, the latest first), done (Complete or Closed, the latest first) and all. A status in the find takes the place of the list's. parentWorkEffortId gives one level of the tree (the view-tree's children, impl-projects.md F13), topLevel the items with no parent, underWorkEffortId the items below one at any depth. A key typed as the text (IRON-12) finds that item. A level of the tree, and a find with no order, is in rank order (sequenceNum) when the tree asks for it (treeOrder).

parameter.name: sprintId
parameter.description: Comma list of sprints, or current: the sprints in progress (of the project when rootWorkEffortId is given)

parameter.name: keyMatch
parameter.description: The id of the item the text named by its key

parameter.name: totals
parameter.description: The estimate, remaining and actual hours of every row of the find (estimatedText, remainingText, actualText), not only the page's

service.description: Work items as WorkItems, its board, calendar and tree and the sub-items show them: the link, the type (purpose) label and icon, the status (label and color), the project, the parent, the assignees (assigneePartyId the first, the board's group), the milestone and release (milestoneId, releaseId), the labels, the due date as text and as a day (the calendar's), the hours and points, the roll-up of the subtree (mantle.work.ProjectServices get#WorkItemTree: childCount, totalEstimatedWorkTime, totalRemainingWorkTime, totalActualWorkTime, doneOfTotal), whether it repeats, and whether the user may change it (canUpdate, as get#TaskAccess with app projects has it).

The projects of the work item drop-downs: the open projects the user sees (get#VisibleProjectInfo), not templates, by name; with memberOnly those the user may add work to (a member, a manager, ADMIN).

The milestones, releases, components or sprints (workEffortTypeEnumId) of a project the user sees, by date then name, as drop-down options (key, text); open ones unless includeClosed (a sprint that is complete is not open).
The labels (WorkEffortCategory WcatLabel) a work item may take: those of the user's organizations, and those of no owner, by name.
The work items one may go under (a parent search): items of the same project, by key or name, leaving out the item and its descendants; a drop-down's options (value, label).

The quick-add rows of WorkItems and of a work item's sub-items, and QuickCreate's QuickWorkItem: a work item in a project the user may add to (mantle.work.TaskServices.create#Task, numbered KEY-n), the user its owner and reporter, with its type, an assignee, a priority, a due date and an estimate, under parentWorkEffortId (an item of the same project) at the end of its siblings, in sprintWorkEffortId when given (a sprint of the project that is not complete); Work group visibility unless the project shares new items (WstShareNewItems Y: General); the project's flow. The context record of quick create is linked to it.

One field of a work item, from an in-place edit, the board or the detail's Edit: due (yyyy-MM-dd, empty clears), priority (1-9), estimate, remaining, points, budget (totalTimeAllowed), start (yyyy-MM-dd), title, type (purpose), visibility, resolution, assignee (the item's assignee replaced; empty unassigns), milestone, release, component (empty takes it out), sprint (mantle.work.TaskServices.set#TaskSprint; empty to the backlog), parent (move#Task, at the end of the new siblings; empty to the top level), label and unlabel (a label id). By a user who may change the item (get#TaskAccess, app projects).

A card moved on the WorkItems board to another column of the field it is grouped by (groupField): the status along the item's flow (set#TaskStatus), else the assignee, priority, milestone, release or sprint (update#WorkItemField).

A bulk change of WorkItems on the selected items (workEffortIds, a list or comma text): assign (partyId), unassign, status (statusId), priority, due (empty clears), milestone, release, sprint (empty takes them out), label and unlabel (labelId), visibility, move to project (rootWorkEffortId; each moves with its subtree, update#Task), move under an item (parentWorkEffortId, empty to the top level) and delete (managers; items with no time, sub-items, comments or files). Each item in its own transaction: one the user may not change, or whose change fails, is logged and counted with its reason, and the others go on.

What Projects' WorkItemDetail shows (design-projects.md §5 WorkItemDetail): the task detail of ironstone.commons.TaskServices.get#TaskDetail with app projects (the flow's stages, the people, the records it is on, time), and the item's path (the project, then each ancestor from the top: breadcrumbs), its type icon, the plan items (milestone, release, sprint, component), labels, the roll-up of its subtree with its own numbers, its sub-items (one level, get#WorkItemTree), its relations (WorkEffortAssoc of the relation kinds, both ways, with the other item's status and the lag of a dependency), the requests it serves, and its repeat rule in words. For a task that is an issue of a repository (Smithy; mr-pass plan/design-smithy.md §8.1, N-BOSS-ISSUE): issue, with its number in the repository, the address of its public page (mantle.smithy.SmithyIssueServices.get#TaskIssue) and its outward conversation, the posts of the issue's topic that Mantle's forum lets this user read (mantle.forum.ForumServices.get#Posts; no rule is added here). Chatter stays the internal notes.
A work item's repeat rule in words: "Every month on the 2nd; next made on completion" (an RRULE of FREQ, INTERVAL, BYDAY, BYMONTHDAY, COUNT and UNTIL; the rest is shown as it is).

A relation of a work item to another of a project the user sees (Links): kind blocks, blockedBy, relatesTo, duplicates, duplicatedBy, causes, causedBy, clones, clonedBy, basedOn; a dependency (blocks, blocked by) with its lag in working days (mantle.work.TaskServices.add#TaskDependency: a loop or a dependency in the item's own branch of the tree is refused). The direction is the WorkEffortAssoc's: workEffortId depends on (is blocked by) toWorkEffortId.

return.message: A work item is not linked to itself

service.description: Ends a relation of a work item (thruDate now), by a user who may change it.

Repeat or stop repeating a work item (WorkItemDetail's Repeat): the rule from frequency (DAILY, WEEKLY, MONTHLY, YEARLY), interval, weekdays (MO,TU…) or a day of the month, and an end (count or until, yyyy-MM-dd); fromCompletion Y counts from the completion day. An empty frequency stops it (mantle.work.TaskServices set#TaskRecurrence).

QuickCreate's QuickProject (design-projects.md §3): a project with a key (one to eight letters or digits, upper case), a name, a client (Customer) and the user as its project manager, General visibility (impl-projects.md F10), the internal organization of the user as its owner and Vendor; from a template project (clone#Project with its tree) when one is given. For Projects managers (BOSS_PROJECT_MANAGER) and ADMIN only (impl-projects.md F8).
